displayTitle: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded
synopsis: Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded is a Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game book written by Bill Smith and published by West End Games in August 1996. It supersedes the first and second editions of the core book.
title: Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded
